title_sq: Tek Liqeni I Thate, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1 Me Oborr Dhe Me Orientim Perfekt !
description_sq: Tek Liqeni i Thate, ne Rrugen Hamdi Sina, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 plus Oborr (Bahce), me siperfaqe 55 m2 me Vendndodhje Perfekte!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3-te te nje pallati te ri te sapoperfunduar me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto prej 114 m² dhe siperfaqe neto prej 102 m2. Organizimi i apartamentit fillon me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me ambientin e ngrenies dhe te gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar, dhoma e femijeve, ballkoni, lavanteri dhe nje tualet tjeter. Orientimi nga jug-lindja e ben te kete drite gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites. Shitesi ka investuar cdo gje nga fillimi (ne vleren 40.000 euro), duke filluar nga sistemi elektrik, sistemi hidraulit, dyer, dritare, parket, tualeti e deri tek ndricimi led. Mobiljet dhe pajisjet elektroshtepiaket jane te markave me te mira ne treg. Zona ofron shume facilitete duke nisur nga lokacioni perfekt, afersia me liqenin e thate dhe liqenin artificial dhe per kete arsye eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per te jetuar ashtu edhe per investim.
title_en: At Lake I Thate, Super Apartment 2+1 With Yard And Perfect Orientation For Sale!
description_en: At Liqeni i Thate, on Hamdi Sina Street, Super Apartment 2+1+2 plus Yard (Bahce) is for sale, with a surface of 55 m2 and a Perfect Location!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building, recently completed with an elevator and well managed. The apartment has a gross area of ​​114 m² and a net area of ​​102 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area and exit to the balcony, matrimonial room with dedicated toilet, children's room, balcony, laundry room and another toilet. Orientation from the south-east makes it light during most of the day. The seller has invested everything from the beginning (to the value of 40,000 euros), starting from the electrical system, the hydraulic system, doors, windows, parquet, toilet and up to the LED lighting. Furniture and household appliances are of the best brands in the market. The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the dry lake and the artificial lake, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment.
